# swarmops queue run

Run REF's queue until it holds no open entry; exit 0 at once when another runner does.

enqueue, wait and the other queue commands start this when a queue has work and no runner: it needs no other driver. It answers the queue as it left it.

```yaml
description: "Run REF's queue until it holds no open entry; exit 0 at once when another runner does."

envelope_op: "queue_run"
exit_codes: [0]

syntax: "swarmops queue run [OPTIONS] <REF>"
```

## Syntax

```text
swarmops queue run [OPTIONS] <REF>
```

## Required arguments

### `REF`

Syntax: `<REF>`.

The ref whose queue it runs.

## Optional arguments

The command also takes the [global options](../cli.md#global-options).

### `--inflight`

Syntax: `--inflight <N>`.
Default: `4`.

How many candidates it checks at once: 1 to 32.

### `--check-timeout`

Syntax: `--check-timeout <S>`.
Default: `900`.

How long one check may run, in seconds.
